notes: fallback formal DSE universe contains only parameters that change generated FPGA RTL/XPM topology
framework physical-domain seed is a read-only topology boundary, not a selected architecture or QoR claim

hard_constraints: Preserve the supplied decoder model facts and operator order: hidden_size=1152, 26 layers, target_max_seq_len=16, MQA with 4 query heads, 1 KV head, head_dim=256, gated MLP intermediate_size=6912, RMSNorm, and the supplied block operator_sequence.
Preserve the supplied query projection shape implied by 4 query heads and head_dim=256; do not alter source hidden_size=1152 or infer missing checkpoint tensor names or contents.

Preserve INT4 learned matrix weights, INT8 activations, INT32 accumulators and bias, nearest-even rounding, saturation, and the supplied integer quantization policy. Do not instantiate floating-point IP.
Support both required semantic stream widths, 8-bit activation and 32-bit accumulator, with each selected lane count satisfying the supplied 512-bit AXI packing rule.
Use integer/fixed-point DSP MACs and physical XPM memories. Reject software arithmetic and ideal-memory backends.
Preserve the target board part and board AXI/DDR shell, signal names, widths, addresses, runtime protocol, and board run command from the supplied target_board_profile.

Use only candidates in the finite universe and only lane/compute_array combinations listed as valid. Do not search metadata-only tile, burst, pipeline-depth, or clock-target fields that are not wired into generated hardware.
Do not change model semantics or bypass DDR, AXI, or runtime constraints.
Repeat the immutable task target exactly: power_report_required=false, source=task_spec.
notes: The seed candidate dimensions are retained with their supplied key names and legal values. The additional valid_lane_compute_array_tuples enumerate the complete lane/row/column combinations after enforcing rows divides lanes.
Every listed lane choice packs both required stream widths into the 512-bit AXI beat with no remainder; no lane choice is included that fails either required width.
No physical_weight_layout_candidates were supplied. Stage 4 must derive the all-URAM baseline using the same semantic contract rather than inventing model-family storage role names.

The numeric policy leaves exact formats or approximations for normalization, activation, Softmax, RoPE, residual scaling, and requantization incomplete, and does not provide the required probability scale. Resolve these contracts before functional promotion; do not silently choose values here.

The numeric comparison values in the supplied policy are framework defaults: atol=0.1, rtol=0.1, and max_mismatch_fraction=0.05 under spatialaccagent.loose_numeric_compare.v1. They are not additional user QoR targets.

The board profile notes that the exact deployment part should be confirmed and that shell details, memory capacity, remote execution host/port, and board smoke pass/fail conditions are not established by the supplied evidence.
objectives: Explore the finite legal hardware candidate universe without changing model semantics, numeric policy, or board AXI/DDR/runtime behavior.
Compare candidates only using subsequent real target-board app-shell Vivado results and hardware-counter measurements; this design space contains no QoR estimates.

correlation_constraints: Only valid_lane_compute_array_tuples are legal lane and compute_array combinations; compute_array.rows must divide lanes.
compute_array.cols must be a power of two and may divide lanes or be an integer multiple of lanes, as supported by the current wide-column template.

fixed_hardware_bindings.physical_memories: XPM BRAM/URAM only; reject software arithmetic and ideal-memory backends

physical_weight_layout_policy.stage_4_action: Derive the complete all-URAM baseline from the model-semantic weight-storage terms in the current semantic contract.
